question: Should staff confirm this ShieldCortex namespace claim and hide/quarantine or rename the `@kingaiwork/shieldcortex` listing, ask for more proof, or decline the claim?
rationale: This requires a staff moderation and supply-chain trust decision against a live ClawHub listing; source changes cannot decide the rightful owner or apply the production moderation state.

options.title: Confirm and moderate the listing
options.body: Verify the public evidence, then hide/quarantine or rename/merge the disputed listing with an audit note and close this issue after the live catalog no longer surfaces the misleading resource.

options.title: Request more proof
options.body: Keep the issue open and ask the claimant for specific additional public or private evidence before taking action.

options.title: Decline with rationale
options.body: Leave the listing visible only if staff determines the evidence does not meet the namespace policy threshold, and post the reason publicly where safe.

recommendation.title: Confirm and moderate the listing
recommendation.body: Verify the public evidence, then hide/quarantine or rename/merge the disputed listing with an audit note and close this issue after the live catalog no longer surfaces the misleading resource.
